data.narrative:
K2 Space is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company founded by Karan and Neel Kunjur that has raised $110M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 private peers at the same stage—Sierra Space, Varda Space Industries, and Skyryse—alongside a broader public reference set of 5 aerospace tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) with a median EV/Sales multiple of 23.9x.

Two quantitative methods triangulate the valuation. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $110M total raised, implying $187M. The peer-median method references 3 same-sector, same-stage companies with a median valuation of $1.5B, though the peer range is wide ($1.1B to $8.0B), reflecting material heterogeneity in this segment. Public-comp anchoring is not applicable as K2's revenue is not disclosed. 

The triangulated analysis suggests a valuation range of $159M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $844M. The wide spread reflects tension between the stage-progression method and peer medians, driven largely by the outsized $8.0B valuation of Sierra Space within the peer set. Key uncertainties include K2's revenue trajectory and technical differentiation relative to better-capitalized competitors. Additional disclosure of unit economics or technology milestones would narrow this range materially.
